newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung in China oil exploration venture.
newsitem.headline: Samsung in China oil exploration venture.

text.p: South Korea's Samsung Corp, a unit of Samsung Group, said on Friday it has agreed to set up a joint venture with China's Lantian Materials Co to explore for oil in western China.
Samsung will invest $42 million by the year 2000 in the joint venture named "Ningxia Samsung Lantian Oil Development Corp Ltd", a company statement said.
The venture will explore for oil in the south of Baiyanjing oil field. Samsung hopes to produce about 1.5 billion barrels in the next 13 years.
The oil will be sold in China, it said.
The statement said Samsung expects an average of $5 million in annual profits.
